business_problem: Ecommerce brands in the maternal-and-infant segment were struggling with scattered consumer data, slow service response, weak demand mining, and delayed discovery of after-sales issues hidden in refunds and conversations. Yuyi Technology needed an AI workflow that could turn large volumes of dialog, review, and return data into real-time customer-service guidance and product or operational insight.
solution_summary: Yuyi Technology combined its NeoSight 5.0 platform with Alibaba Cloud's Qwen large model to build an end-to-end customer-service and voice- of-customer analysis stack for a maternal-and-infant commerce scenario. Real-time conversations are analyzed for user intent, automatically labeled, and routed into standard-answer guidance so frontline service teams can respond faster and more consistently. NeoTrainer AI then simulates high-frequency consultation scenarios to improve agent preparedness, while VOC analysis over comments and feedback extracts structured defect or demand tags such as color mismatch or material sensitivity and links them back to specific SKUs. LabelPaas extends the same data model into refund and return analysis so the brand can identify recurring causes such as fulfillment delay or description mismatch. The result is a closed loop in which AI parses user signals, business teams act on them, and service, product, and supply-chain processes are updated continuously.

solution_components.name: Qwen large model
solution_components.role: Provides intent understanding, labeling, and semantic analysis across conversations, comments, and feedback.

solution_components.name: NeoSight 5.0
solution_components.role: Acts as the operational platform for service analytics, user insight, and closed-loop execution.

solution_components.name: NeoTrainer AI
solution_components.role: Simulates high-frequency customer-service scenarios to train and improve frontline service performance.

solution_components.name: LabelPaas
solution_components.role: Analyzes refund and return orders to identify root causes and feed process improvements.

data_flow: Customer-service dialogs, reviews, and feedback are sent through NeoSight and Qwen for intent recognition, tagging, and VOC analysis. Structured results then flow to service guidance, product and R&D teams, and refund-root-cause workflows in LabelPaas, where recurring issues can be linked to specific SKUs and turned into product, service, or supply-chain improvements.
business_outcome: Yuyi Technology helped the brand move from passive service response to proactive customer understanding. The program lifted service-management efficiency by 51.7%, improved first-line customer-service conversion by 30.8%, raised risk-insight efficiency by 80%, pushed store satisfaction to 95.5%, and increased online conversion by 32.7% by turning AI analysis into a repeatable user-feedback-to-action loop.
architecture_clues: The platform uses one semantic layer to process live dialogs, reviews, and refund data instead of splitting those signals into separate tools.
Qwen outputs are converted into structured tags that can be linked back to specific SKUs and business workflows.
Training and enablement are part of the production architecture through NeoTrainer AI, not a separate post-processing step.
The end state is a closed loop from user signal to AI analysis to business response and validation.
